caseSubject.title: Case Subject
caseSubject.description: Short Case subject for AI case analysis. Do not include raw names, emails, phone numbers, account IDs, payment data, or exact addresses.

caseDescription.title: Case Description
caseDescription.description: Case description for AI case analysis. Use a sanitized summary; common identifiers are masked before provider calls.

caseStatus.title: Case Status
caseStatus.description: Optional Salesforce Case status, for example New, Working, or Escalated.

caseType.title: Case Type
caseType.description: Optional Salesforce Case type, for example Outage, Billing, or Technical.

caseOrigin.title: Case Origin
caseOrigin.description: Optional Salesforce Case origin, for example Phone, Email, Web, or Chat.

reportedPriority.title: Reported Priority
reportedPriority.description: Optional reported priority: low, normal, high, or critical.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Optional safe correlation id for backend telemetry.
